_source: ollama.com/pricing read 26 September 2026; Anthropic rates from the Claude API model table (cached 24 June 2026). Prices are per million tokens. Check them before trusting a cost figure: they change, and this file is a snapshot.
_not_applied: Ollama also publishes a cached-input rate (gpt-oss:20b $0.035/Mtok), but its API response does not report cached tokens, so every input token is priced at the full rate. Logged costs are therefore an upper bound. Off-peak rates exist for some models but not for gpt-oss:20b.
